title: Memories that remain: Image memorability transfers to scene descriptions
authors: Diana Kollenda, Yee Lee Shing, Katharina Dobs, Benjamin de Haas
caption_short: (a) Example target and lure scenes of high and low predicted memorability with their written descriptions. (b) Procedure: encoding phase with an indoor / outdoor judgement on 80 stimuli, a short break, then a retrieval phase on 160 stimuli asking whether each was seen before, followed by a free-text question.
